description: Legacy enterprise invoicing and marginal tariff settlement engine. Stripped decompilation decouples progressive tax brackets (0x00405000) and customer loyalty tier matrices (0x00405080) from line-item settlement loops. FalkorDB multi-agent swarm maps memory provenance and resolves call topology into compilable, audit-grade modern C.
